location_exception_reason: Cattle sheds are regionally optimised for agro-climatic zones (tropical, semi-arid, temperate); location signals buyer-relevant design choices (ventilation, roofing material, drainage) and supplier proximity for on-site erection and after-sales support.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, Fabricator) describe the seller's role, not the product itself; removing them leaves the product definition intact and complete. IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this distinction to buyers independently.
